name: spreng
description: Spreng plugins: the Spreng connector, plus optional add-ons for Claude Code image sources and local research collectors.

plugins.name: spreng
plugins.description: Connects your Spreng account: Spreng prepares research reads, angles and ad image plans, your own assistant writes the text and makes the images, and Spreng saves your research, angles and plans.

plugins.name: spreng-images
plugins.description: Claude Code add-on: lets Claude Code make images through a source you choose once (your Codex CLI, your own OpenAI key or your own KIE key). Keys stay on your computer.

plugins.name: spreng-research
plugins.description: Add-on: local collectors for research (Meta Ad Library first batch with media saved straight away, Reddit public feeds, YouTube comments, local speech-to-text for ad videos).
